name: BLDC motors
summary: Brushless outrunner motors that turn electrical power into propeller thrust.
whyItMatters: The motor sets how much thrust you get per watt, how hot the system runs and how long it lasts between services.
acceptance: KV within the stated tolerance on every unit, unloaded, at a stated voltage
Phase resistance measured on every unit, four-wire
Shaft runout and bearing noise checked by hand on every unit
Magnet and wire origin declared in writing for the batch
documents: Datasheet with KV, resistance, mass and rated cells
Magnet wire class and origin declaration
Thrust or torque test data for one unit

name: ESCs
summary: Electronic speed controllers that switch battery power into the three motor phases.
whyItMatters: The ESC decides how cleanly and how safely current reaches the motor, and it is a common point of failure under heat.
acceptance: Visual inspection of solder joints and connectors on every unit
Power-on and function test on every unit, results logged by serial number
Firmware version recorded and matching the agreed version
Bill of materials with the origin of every major chip, for the batch
documents: Bill of materials with chip makers and origin

name: Flight controllers
summary: Boards that read the sensors, run the control loop and command each motor.
whyItMatters: Sensor quality and processor headroom decide how stable the aircraft is and which autopilot software it can run.
acceptance: Visual inspection of solder joints and connectors on every unit
Power-on and function test on every unit, results logged by serial number
Firmware version recorded and matching the agreed version
Bill of materials with the origin of every major chip, for the batch
documents: Bill of materials with chip makers and origin

name: GNSS modules
summary: Satellite navigation receivers with antenna and compass, including NavIC support.
whyItMatters: Position is the one input an autonomous aircraft cannot do without, and most GNSS modules in Indian drones are imported.
acceptance: Visual inspection of solder joints and connectors on every unit
Power-on and function test on every unit, results logged by serial number
Firmware version recorded and matching the agreed version
Time to first fix and satellite count logged outdoors on every unit
documents: Bill of materials with chip makers and origin
Receiver chip maker and supported constellations

name: Propellers
summary: Fixed and folding propellers matched to motor size and aircraft class.
whyItMatters: Propeller shape and balance drive efficiency, noise and vibration, which the flight controller then has to filter out.
acceptance: Diameter, pitch and mass measured on every unit
Static and dynamic balance on every unit
Visual check for voids, cracks and edge damage
Material certificate for the batch

name: Carbon-fibre frames
summary: Carbon-fibre airframes and arms that hold every other part in place.
whyItMatters: Frame stiffness changes vibration, and vibration changes everything from sensor noise to motor bearing life.
acceptance: Critical dimensions measured on the first article and on a sample from each batch
Mass of every unit within the stated tolerance
Material certificate for the batch
Visual check for cracks, delamination or burrs

name: Robot joint actuators
summary: Integrated joints with a frameless motor, strain wave gear, encoder and drive.
whyItMatters: Joints decide what a robot arm or humanoid can lift and how precisely, and they share magnets, bearings and windings with drone motors.
acceptance: Rated and peak torque measured on the first article
Backlash and lost motion measured on every unit
Encoder counts and direction checked on every unit
Magnet origin declared in writing for the batch
documents: Datasheet with torque, speed, ratio and backlash

name: AGV and AMR drive wheels
summary: Hub motor drive wheels with gearbox, brake and encoder for warehouse and factory robots.
whyItMatters: The drive wheel sets payload, speed and duty cycle for a mobile robot, and it is the part that wears first.
acceptance: No-load speed and current measured on every unit
Brake holding torque checked on every unit
Tyre hardness and diameter measured per batch
Evidence for the stated ingress rating
documents: Datasheet with load, speed, torque and duty cycle

name: Server fans
summary: High static pressure fans for servers, storage and network switches.
whyItMatters: Air-cooled servers fail on heat before anything else, and fans are the moving part that wears out.
acceptance: Speed and current at rated voltage measured on every unit
Tach and PWM signals checked on every unit
Noise and vibration measured on a sample per batch
Bearing type and rated life declared for the batch
documents: Datasheet with airflow, pressure and power curves
Bearing type and rated life data
Motor driver chip maker and origin

name: Server power supplies
summary: Hot-swap CRPS power supplies for servers and AI racks.
whyItMatters: A power supply failure takes a server down, and conversion efficiency at this scale is a large share of a data center power bill.
acceptance: Output voltage, ripple and efficiency at 20, 50 and 100 percent load on every unit
Hi-pot test on every unit
PMBus readout checked on every unit
Safety certificate covering the exact model
documents: Datasheet with efficiency curve and hold-up time
Safety and EMC certificates for the model
Bill of materials with origin of power semiconductors

name: Liquid cooling
summary: Cold plates and fittings for direct-to-chip liquid cooling of CPUs and GPUs.
whyItMatters: AI racks now produce more heat than air can remove, so cold plates are moving from niche to standard.
acceptance: Pressure or leak test on every unit, results logged by serial number
Flatness of contact faces measured on the first article and per batch
Material and plating certificates for the batch
Cleanliness check: no loose particles in fluid paths
documents: Pressure drop and thermal resistance data at stated flow

name: Batteries and cells
summary: Lithium-ion and lithium-polymer cells and packs.
whyItMatters: Cell chemistry and origin carry the largest safety and supply risk in most drone builds.

name: Chips and sensors
summary: Processors, IMUs, barometers, GNSS modules and radios.
whyItMatters: Chips are where counterfeit and remarked parts most often enter a supply chain, and where origin is hardest to trace.

name: Gimbals and cameras
summary: Stabilised camera payloads and imaging modules.
whyItMatters: Payloads often carry the most sensitive components, so procurement rules for them are usually the strictest.

name: Transformers and switchgear
summary: Medium-voltage transformers, switchgear and busway for new data center halls.
whyItMatters: Lead times for transformers and switchgear now set how fast new capacity can be built, so verified alternatives matter.
